releases.body:
Finish the windowsHide sweep the first pass missed

Issue #6: the fix that followed #5 covered three plugins but missed three
more, and the one that polls git status every few seconds flashed a console
window each time on Windows. The flag now covers everything that spawns.


Record: docs/oc-models-pro.md

issues.title: [oc-git] Windows: Git status polling flashes visible console windows every ~3 seconds
Windows: suppress console windows from plugin check/update subprocess
